cwc.note: "the show clips playlist PLUS every tailored playlist that fits" (Colden 2026-09-15). Patterns are matched AS WRITTEN (case-sensitive) on title A + summary only. The three unverified ids look truncated in edit-clips config - never used until checked against the channel.

thumbnail.rules: A = his pick of 4 (confirmed still, still + hook overlay, two AI); B = the confirmed still + the hook overlay with the headline of title B; C = regenerated from title C with the model of A (gpt_image_2 when A is not AI). Anything on @ColdenRaisher features Colden (A, B and C). Real still: ruling 39 (eyes to camera / straight ahead, eyes open, confirmed smile by default; teeth are fine on a real smile). AI: likeness from a clean episode still, ONE visual idea, at most THREE words of huge text, no logos, no microphones, no AirPods, closed-lip grin with NO TEETH, never a real third party's likeness or real film art. Full text: references/carried_rules.md.
thumbnail.still_rule: Colden 2026-10-02: "Real thumbnail must have eyes at the camera (or looking straight forward because Jake does not look straight to camera) and default should be smiling emotion with smile confirmed. If other emotion is the main focus and you can find a confirmed still, use, if not, default to smiling. Other emotions- angry, confused, laughing" -> thumbs.py frames (Vision pose + pupils) -> LOOK -> thumbs.py still (confirmation)

title.rules: no em dash; the hook in the first ~45 characters; A/B/C first 5 words all differ; never a title he did not pick as B or C; announced is not released (claims from the transcript, verified)

pinned.rules: an engagement question, two short sentences max, no links, never "drop it below / comment below / let me know / link in"

packaging.full_episode_rule: Colden 2026-10-02: each live goes up twice per channel; the title ending in the phone emoji is the mobile / vertical stream - never link to it, link the one without it (package.full_episode; public uploads only)

full_episode.note: the Creative Lens live on each channel: PUBLIC, title carries "Ep. NN", not the phone-emoji (vertical) copy (ruling 38); Colden and Todd lives are on @ColdenRaisher too and are excluded by title
